system.description:
• Effect: Once per day, declare before rolling. If the shot hits, two of its damage dice explode once, whatever they rolled: roll each again and add it (the new die explodes as normal).
  • More dice: three dice at 9th level, and every damage die from 12th.

activities.name: Perfect Shot
activities.text: Once per day, declared before rolling: if your shot hits, {1:two of its damage dice, 9:three of its damage dice, 12:every damage die} explode once, whatever they rolled (roll each again and add it; the new die explodes as normal).
